title: Rosemary Beach: Blue Sky Breeze Loft in Rosemary Beach – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: Rosemary Beach: Blue Sky Breeze Loft in Rosemary Beach. Welcome to the "Blue Sky Breeze Loft" in the heart of charming Rosemary Beach! Nestled on the north side of Barrett Square, this stunning 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo offers the epitome of coastal luxury and convenience.
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

Welcome to the "Blue Sky Breeze Loft" in the heart of charming Rosemary Beach! Nestled on the north side of Barrett Square, this stunning 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo offers the epitome of coastal luxury and convenience.

The open floor plan seamlessly combines the living, dining, and kitchen areas, creating a spacious and inviting atmosphere perfect for entertaining or relaxing with family and friends. Adorned with coastal chic furniture, the living area features comfortable seating and French doors that open onto a private balcony overlooking the vibrant Barrett Square below.

The fully furnished kitchen boasts modern appliances and all the amenities you need for preparing delicious meals during your stay. Enjoy your morning coffee or savor an evening cocktail on the balcony, soaking in the sights and sounds of Rosemary Beach.

With three bedrooms, there's plenty of space for everyone to unwind and recharge after a day of adventure. Need to catch up on work? Take advantage of the desk provided for a quiet workspace.

Additional amenities include in-unit laundry, dedicated parking, and complimentary access to the beach, pool, tennis courts, and fitness facilities. Plus, with coded access to the building and included bikes for exploring the area, convenience is key during your stay.

Located on the second floor and accessible via elevator, the "Blue Sky Breeze Loft" offers the perfect blend of luxury, comfort, and convenience for your Rosemary Beach getaway. Book your stay today and experience the best that the Gulf Coast has to offer!

Parking spot behind building.

Disclaimer: Active balcony construction on neighboring building during January-Mid-April 2026.
